profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is a public company, traded under the ticker PONY, headquartered in Guangzhou. Its own site describes it as an autonomous driving technology company founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, working toward what it calls an ambitious vision for autonomous mobility: safe, sustainable, and accessible mobility worldwide. The company says it has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios and that its vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024. It also states that it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations around the world.

Pony AI organizes its work around a core technology it calls the "virtual driver" and three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). The company describes itself as an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving, serving both everyday travel and commercial logistics, and says it is committed to developing the safest autonomous driving capabilities on a global scale.

The company's SEC filing record lists it under CIK 0001969302. No litigation, no tracked product listings, and no MCP servers appear in the record held for it.
